newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.50 pct at Italy BOT buyback.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.50 pct at Italy BOT buyback.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 2.5 trillion lire buyback of short term Treasury bills (BOTs) by the Bank of Italy was 6.50 percent compared with 6.75 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.62 percent against 6.78 percent at the previous operation for 2.0 trillion lire on February 10.
The Bank said the amount taken up was 2.246 trillion compared to the 2.5 trillion offer and it received 14 bids of which all were met in full.
